StyledText.Data: # About this layout - This layout is used by bitbucket pipeline to generate SaXML. - The layout name must be SaXMLDeliveryExecutionContext. - The layout must contain an xmlFile field. - The layout table does not need to contain any records. # FileMaker configuration Per file: - Install add-on (you don't need to apply the add-on to any layout) - This will create the following: - SaXMLDelivery table with xmlFile and other fields - SaXMLDeliveryExecutionContext layout with xmlFile and other fields - saxmlDelivery family of scripts - Set up an account that can be used with the Data API ("fmrest" extended privilege) Per server: - Install a valid SSL certificate (required by the Data API) - Enable the Data API # Bitbucket configuration - Set up a repository with a pipeline that calls fm-saxml-delivery - See https://github.com/soliantconsulting/fm-saxml-delivery - You'll need to set up the appropriate environment variables in the repository - Run the pipeline on a schedule and/or ad hoc
